notes.title: July 4th 2025 Patch
notes.content:
Added Polish, Russian, Czech, Hungarian, Simplified Chinese in the Worldwide builds on UC and Steam, for the main game and its 2 addons.
Enhanced security.

notes.title: Upcoming Localization Expansion!
notes.content: [p]Greetings Heroes![/p][p]We're excited to share some news regarding [b]Heroes of Might and Magic V[/b]![/p][h3]What's New:[/h3][list][*][p]We are in the process of localizing Heroes of Might and Magic V into several new languages:[/p][list][*][p][b]Polish (POL)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Russian (RU)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Czech (CZE)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hungarian (HUN)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Simplified Chinese (SCH)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Important Note for Players:[/h3][p]Please be aware that while we are preparing for this update, you might notice these new language options appearing in the game's selection screen if you install the game now.[/p][p][b]However, these languages are not yet fully integrated and will not function correctly until a future build update.[/b] We are still in the process of testing and integrating all the necessary files.[/p][p]We kindly ask for your patience as we finalize this expansion. We'll announce another update once the full localization build is live and ready for you to enjoy in your preferred language![/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and understanding.[/p][p]The Heroes of Might and Magic V Team[/p]
